methodology: The ranked list contains only results from the RTX 4070 node above. Historical fields that were not captured in the same run are shown as not recorded instead of being inferred. Community hardware is kept in a separate, unranked dataset. Retired profiles keep their last measured performance in the archive tab; they are no longer reproducible on this node.

gemma-4-26b-qat-mtp.summary: Current startup preload and the best quality/speed balance in the Gemma set.

gemma-4-26b-qat.summary: Full model without speculative drafting; useful as the MTP control profile.

qwen3-6-mtp-q6.summary: Higher-precision Q6 variant; slower, but useful when Q4 quality is not enough.

qwen38-flash-next.summary: 125B-A6B MoE with the 51B PLE n-gram table streamed from SSD (AtomicChat AD-4.27bpw). Spec-warm counting-probe tg 24.8-25.4 (25.7-26.3 with performance power profile); novel-prose floor 19.5 t/s. ngram-mod speculation on predictable/repeated content reaches 35.9 t/s.
qwen38-flash-next.cacheState: warm; q8_0 KV, ngram-mod pool warm

qwen38-flash-next-exp.summary: Gold flags on the exp stack (master + #28023 #28068 #27941): GDN l2norm correctness, indexer-heads fix, kvu NaN-collapse/restore. A/B vs gold was a speed wash; this tier exists for the correctness fixes.
qwen38-flash-next-exp.cacheState: warm; q8_0 KV, ngram-mod pool warm

qwen38-flash-next-mtp.summary: Exp stack + #27836 MTP draft head (Q4_K_M sidecar fully in VRAM). Gated drafting (--spec-draft-p-min 0.7): code tg +15-26% at prose parity; ungated dn=2 is a net loss. 32k ctx cap is the price of the head in VRAM.
qwen38-flash-next-mtp.quant: AD-4.27bpw Q4_K_M M64 + Q4_K_M MTP head

qwen3-8-27b-iq3-xxs.summary: Dense 27B hybrid; middle quant tier. Fits the native 262k window in VRAM with q5_0/q4_1 KV at ~36.7 t/s — the long-context + quality play on 12 GB.
